Case note: Complaint No. 1984/2021
Client: Sujata Krishnan (dentist, Warangal)
Opposing party: Aravali Industries
Court: Warangal Labour Court
Filed on: 6 June 2021
Claim amount: ₹6,60,000
Issue: wrongful termination. The employer withheld the last salary.
Advice given: File a claim for unpaid wages before the labour authority.
Outcome: The unpaid wages were recovered.
Recommended next step: Close the file.
Witness: Kiran Malhotra
